title: Obcordate
summary: OBCORD'ATE, adjective [Latin from ob and cor, the heart.] In botany, shaped like a heart, with the apex downward; as an obcordate petal or legume.

inlines.v: OBCORD'ATE, adjective [Latin from ob and cor, the heart.] In botany, shaped like a heart, with the apex downward; as an obcordate petal or legume.
